title: Four Hours and Seven Rivets
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：airport　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 airport 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my father took the ① airport bus for the first time, to meet a man he had never seen, and said the word airport is the only word in English that sounds like an apology. He stood ② at the airport for four hours because the plane was seven hours late, and he said an airport is a building designed for waiting, and that nobody has ever improved on that.

The  airport bus ran nine times a day and once on Sundays, and he took it for thirty-one years without ever going anywhere. Every ③ airport chair in the building had the same seven rivets, and he said an airport is the only place where the furniture is chosen by somebody who will never sit in it.

There was no ④ international airport within nine hundred miles in 1968, and my mother said the phrase means a building with two kinds of queue. She went through ⑤ airport security for the first time in 1979 and said it was the only queue in the world that apologises while it searches you; an airport, she said, is a queue with a roof on it.

The ⑥ airport at the edge of the town, meaning the small one with the grass, closed in 1974 and is now a car park. The ⑦ airport he had known, meaning the strip and not the building, was nine hundred yards of grass and a shed, and he said a field with a shed is an airport if somebody says it is; every airport, he said, was a field once.

The ⑧ airport I remember is the one where he stood for four hours in 1961 and met a man he never saw again. An  airport, my mother said in 1996, is the only building people leave in order to arrive somewhere else; every airport is somebody's last room in one country and first room in another, and she said it at the gate and never repeated it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （小型）航空站；小机场
D. n. （飞机的）起降场；跑道区
E. 固定搭配：at the airport 在机场
F. 固定搭配：airport bus / shuttle 机场巴士／摆渡车
G. 固定搭配：airport security 机场安检
H. 固定搭配：international airport 国际机场

items.q: the airport bus for the first time
at the airport for four hours
Every airport chair in the building
airport security for the first time
The airport at the edge of the town

answers.why: airport bus 意为“机场巴士”，1961 年父亲第一次坐机场巴士，去接一个他从未见过的人。
at the airport 意为“在机场”，因为飞机晚点七小时，他在机场站了四个小时。
airport 作定语，意为“机场的”，楼里每一把机场座椅上都有同样的七颗铆钉。
international airport 意为“国际机场”，1968 年方圆九百英里内没有国际机场。
airport security 意为“机场安检”，1979 年她第一次过机场安检。
airport 意为“（小型）航空站”，镇边那个草地小机场 1974 年关了，如今是停车场。
airport 意为“起降场、跑道区”，他熟悉的那个机场指的不是楼，而是九百码草地加一间棚屋。
airport 意为“机场”，我记得的是 1961 年他站了四个小时、接了一个此后再没见过的人的那个机场。
